verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is an SDK for running isolated code execution environments. A built-in assistant is a fair question for this kind of developer product, but the evidence shows no built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to. The docs only describe the product as infrastructure for building your own AI agents (docs-24). That is a developer building block, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
